name: discover/discover-section
title: DiscoverSection
summary: One band of a Discover page: eyebrow, heading, description and a "See all" link over its content. A featured rail is a DiscoverSection holding a ResultGrid.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: A short label above the heading.

props.name: seeAllHref
props.description: Where "See all" goes; no link without it.

props.name: seeAllLabel
props.description: Say what "all" is, e.g. "See every circle".

props.name: id
props.description: The section's id; its heading is `<id>-title`. Unique per page.

props.name: state
props.description: "ok" or "empty": empty hides the whole band, heading included. A server-filled shell may pass a placeholder.

behaviour: A <section> labelled by its heading, so it is a named region.
"See all" is a link styled as an outline button.
`state="empty"` hides the band (`data-state` and a class), so a section whose data came back empty disappears without template logic.

props.title: Circles worth joining
props.description: A few of the busiest open circles.

props.title: Find circles by what you love

empty.description: A section whose data came back empty.

keyboard: The "See all" link, then the content.
aria: aria-labelledby names the region by its heading.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The heading block and "See all" share a row and wrap below it when narrow; padding grows from 48rem.
contract:
contract
  slot is "discover-section"
  when default shows h2 "Circles worth joining"
  when default shows a "See every circle"
  when muted shows h3 "Find circles by what you love"
  when muted class contains "bg-secondary"
  a "See every circle" min_height 48
  when empty class contains "data-[state=empty]:hidden"
end
